_doc: PRICE_DEFAULTS: the price and opening defaults the world uses when a caller does not give them. shop_price: the coin price of a shop's goods (per unit). shop_is_open: 1 if a new shop is expected to be open (the market expectation seeded for residents). stock_price: the asking price of goods a person puts up for sale. labour_wage: the wage default of the retired sell_labor call. Model defaults, not sourced prices (APPROX).
